Performance implications include runtime costs for normalization of weights and interval checks during random number generation, which are not compile-time constants. Runtime behavior dominates here, as actual random number generation occurs at execution time, contrasting with compile-time aspects like template resolution, which can lead to longer compile times for complex UnaryOperations due to code bloat.
